card.title: Slower than your normal after short sleep
card.whatChanged: Your reaction speed is 1.9 SD below your own normal. You slept 5.2 hours.
card.whyItMatters: On the ISS, reaction speed on this test was slower after 6 hours of sleep or less.
whatToDo: Put off precision tasks that can wait.
Ask a crewmate to double-check critical steps today.
Plan a full sleep period tonight.

sources.title: Sleep deficiency in spaceflight is associated with degraded neurobehavioral functions and elevated stress in astronauts on six-month missions aboard the International Space Station (Jones et al., 2022)
